mapper.sql: result_id as id, result_name as name, result_value as value, target_id as targetId, cre_time as creTime

mapper.insert: INSERT INTO tb_result (result_id, result_name, result_value, target_id, cre_time) VALUES (#{result.id}, #{result.name}, #{result.value}, #{result.targetId}, #{result.creTime}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE result_name = CASE WHEN target_id=VALUES(target_id) THEN VALUES(result_name) ELSE result_name END, result_value = CASE WHEN target_id=VALUES(target_id) THEN VALUES(result_value) ELSE result_value END, cre_time = CASE WHEN target_id=VALUES(target_id) THEN VALUES(cre_time) ELSE cre_time END;
